messages: maria: Quick design review — API keys page. Putting a few screenshots and ideas here, want quick takes before the sync. maria: Problem statements: (1) "Create key" feels lonely in empty state, users aren't sure what scope to pick. (2) Rotate flow modal is too modal-heavy — we lose context. (3) Revoke confirmation feels scary; no easy undo path. teo: I like calling out scope recommendations in the empty state. Maybe a small exemplar row: \"Example: read-only app token (embeddings only)\" with a 1-click create-from-example CTA. evam: +1. Also propose a microcopy change for the rotate modal: current heading "Rotate key" -> "Rotate key (creates a new secret)" — clearer about implications. maria: Good. Also accessibility nit: when secret is revealed we need an aria-live region announcing "Secret revealed; copy now" so screen reader users know a new sensitive value is present. sam: UX nit on the revoke flow: we show a big red danger section then two CTAs: Revoke and Cancel. Suggest adding a lightweight "Soft revoke (disable)" option so users can recover for 24h instead of hard-delete. Copy: "Disable key — can be re-enabled within 24 hours." small help text under the button. teo: For bulk actions: current multi-select shows Revoke only. Customer ask was disable + rotate-in-place. Add a secondary dropdown for bulk action variants. aria: Copy suggestions for revoke modal body: current: "Are you sure? This will revoke access." Proposed alternatives: [A] "Revoke access immediately. This cannot be undone." [B] "Disable access for 24 hours (recoverable)." Use A for hard revoke, B for soft revoke. Keep the emphasized token name inline: \"Revoke key 'my-service-prod'?\" maria: Layout question: should the revoke confirmation use a full modal or a bottom-sheet? On long lists modals feel heavy. Maybe use a compact inline drawer that slides from right; keeps context and allows quick scan of other keys. sam: Inline drawer seems nice. Needs keyboard trap handling for a11y. Also ensure focus returns to the row on close. evam: Microcopy for create flow: The scope selector is confusing. Proposed helper: "What does each scope let the key do?" with a hover / tooltip that lists one-line examples (e.g., embeddings only: search, vector DB store). Also add a small usage estimate: "Estimated cost per 1k tokens: $0.02" (or label as estimate). aria: Accessibility: toolkit checklist — (1) proper labels for scope radio groups, (2) announce changes to list when a key is created via aria-live, (3) visible focus ring on key rows when keyboard navigating, (4) ensure color contrast for danger banners meets AA. maria: Design-bot run: suggested CTAs and copy variants attached. dev-friendly snippet for sample create-from-template button: ``\n\nCreates a key pre-scoped to embeddings and read-only access\n`` teo: One more: empty state should mention last step — "What should I do next?" include 3 cards: Quickstart snippet, Create sample key, Read permissions docs. Keep CTAs focused: primary is create sample key. sam: Concerning analytics: add event names: key_create_start, key_create_from_example, key_rotate_confirm, key_revoke_soft, key_revoke_hard. Helps measure friction. evam: For the rotate flow itself: propose inline 2-step flow instead of modal: (1) create new key and show short-lived secret in a top banner with copy CTA, (2) background rotate tokens for services on request or let user switch over manually. Copy for banner: "New key created — copy now. It will be hidden after you leave this view." and a small "I rotated my services" checkbox to mark completion. maria: OK owners: design will iterate on empty state + create-from-example card (@teo), rotate inline flow prototype (@evam), revoke soft-delete option + inline drawer (@sam). Accessibility review (aria + focus) assigned to @aria. aria: I'll schedule a quick-a11y pass after prototypes. Also can we add a small automated snackbar message for clipboard copy with role=status? e.g., "API key copied to clipboard" so screen readers announce. maria: Thanks. If no blockers we'll ship the copy variants and wireframe updates by EOD Tue. If anyone has microcopy alternatives post here. teo: small wording tweak: prefer "Disable" over "Soft revoke". Less jargony. sam: noted. I'll mock disable option in the drawer. maria: great — closing notes: tracker tickets to create: PROD-keys-emptystate, PROD-keys-rotate-inline, PROD-keys-disable-drawer, PROD-keys-a11y. I'll create them and link in thread.
